question: Who has to approve a $700 refund?
query: refund approval authority levels policy $700 manager approval threshold
answer: A $700 refund is over $500, so it needs Tomas Reyes's approval [1][2][3]. It doesn't reach the $2,000 level that requires Priya Whitcomb-Nair [1][2]. Record the approval as a note on the ticket from the approver, not a verbal okay [1].

[1] customer-service-playbook.md > Goodwill and approvals
## Goodwill and approvals

You may give a goodwill credit of up to $25 per incident without approval: a discount code, a
free mantle pack, a refunded shipping charge. Log it on the ticket with a one-line reason.

Above $25, ask the shift lead. The Three Lights rule covers larger amounts: any refund, credit or
goodwill over $500 needs the approval of Tomas Reyes, and anything over $2,000 needs the approval
of Priya Whitcomb-Nair. "Any" means any: a refund that is simply the price of a returned Sentinel
1000 Pro and a Northstar together is over $500 and needs Tomas's sign-off before it is released,
even though the policy clearly allows it. Approvals are recorded on the ticket as a note from the
approver, not as a verbal okay.

[2] returns-policy.md > Approvals: the Three Lights rule
## Approvals: the Three Lights rule

Any refund, credit or goodwill gesture over $500 on a single order needs the approval of Tomas
Reyes before it is issued. Anything over $2,000 needs the approval of Priya Whitcomb-Nair. Agents
may issue goodwill credits of up to $25 per incident on their own authority. The approval is
recorded as a note on the order in Hearth with the approver's name and the date. The rule takes
its name from the three lights on the old warehouse sign and is explained in full in the Customer
Service Playbook.

[3] employee-handbook.md > Customer service standards
## Customer service standards

Every email to help@lanternsupply.example is answered within 1 business day, and most are answered
the same day. A phone caller should wait less than 3 minutes; if the queue is longer than that,
the shift lead pulls in a second person. Chat on the online store follows the same 3-minute
standard during support hours and shows the next-day email promise outside them.

Know the policies before you quote them. The return window is 40 days from the delivery date,
the standard warranty is 2 years, and the full details are in the returns policy, the shipping
policy, the warranty policy and the customer service playbook. Any refund, credit or goodwill over
$500 needs approval from Tomas Reyes, Head of Customer Service, and anything over $2,000 needs
Priya Whitcomb-Nair's. Do not promise what you cannot approve.

[4] employee-handbook.md > Employee discount
## Employee discount

Every employee, full-time or part-time, gets 30% off the retail price of anything we sell, in the
showrooms or on the online store, and 50% off Second Light refurbished items. The discount applies
to merchandise, not to shipping, repairs or gift cards. Employees may spend up to $2,000 a year at
the discounted price; purchases past the cap are at retail. The cap resets on January 1.

The discount is for you and the people in your household. Buying discounted items to resell, or
for friends outside your household, is a conduct violation and ends the discount. Use the
discount code on your employee ID card online, or give your employee number at the register. Your
discounted purchases still earn Lumen Rewards points on the amount you actually paid.
